name: Borough of Redditch Local Plan No. 4 (2011-2030)

housing-numbers.notes: Around 3,000 dwellings can be accommodated within Redditch Borough boundaries. Approximately 3,400 dwellings to be accommodated in Bromsgrove District through cross-boundary development at Foxlydiate (2800) and Brockhill East (600). Total allocated sites within borough: 2873 dwellings. Cross-boundary sites are strategic allocations outside borough boundaries.
